note: Rival manager quotes for Card Manager. Family-safe, gentle, one sentence, kid-legible. {team} = the player's club name.

suarez_fc.name: Suárez FC
taunts: Handballs? I call them hugs for the ball.
I only bite into sandwiches these days. Promise.
Rules are more like suggestions, no?
Check your shin pads. Actually, check everything.
The referee and I are very good friends. Too good, some say.
We win one way or another. Usually another.
pre_match: Good luck, {team}. You will need it. I made sure.
I have studied the rulebook. For loopholes.
My team is hungry today. Not like that. Mostly.
Play your best. We will play our sneakiest.
The pitch is fine. Ignore anything you find in it.
May the best team win. Or, you know, us.
post_win: A fair result. Stop looking at me like that.
Every goal was legal. Nearly every goal.
We won with heart. And maybe a hand.
Delicious victory. I could just bite it.
The ref saw nothing. Because nothing happened.
You played well. We played creatively.
post_loss: The referee saw everything today. So unfair.
We were robbed. By people playing properly.
Fine. You won. This time the rules worked.
I demand a rematch. And softer rules.
Losing tastes terrible. I know. I bit it.
Well played, {team}. I hate saying that.

kane_united.name: Kane United
taunts: This is our year. It is always our year.
We never lose finals. We avoid them entirely.
Second place is just first place with humility.
We are unbeatable. Until roughly minute eighty.
Our trophy cabinet is spotless. And empty.
You should worry. We nearly win everything.
pre_match: Today is the day. I can feel it. Again.
We have a good feeling. We always do.
No slip-ups this time. Probably.
We practised penalties all week. Mostly the sky.
History says we fade late. Ignore history.
Win or learn. We have learned so much.
post_win: See? Told you it was our year. Finally.
We did not bottle it! Someone write this down.
Held our nerve. First time for everything.
Never in doubt. Only slightly in doubt.
The curse is broken. Nobody touch anything.
We won! Quick, end the season now.
post_loss: So close. We are always so close.
We led for ages. The ending is just details.
Next year is our year. I am certain again.
We ran out of minutes, not talent.
That one went over. The important ones always do.
Typical. Brilliant until it mattered.

haaland_machine.name: Golazo City
taunts: Analysis complete. You lose.
I do not predict goals. I schedule them.
Resistance noted. Outcome unchanged.
My striker is not human. This is not an insult.
Your defence has one flaw. It is facing us.
We do not do drama. We do goals.
pre_match: Forecast: goals. Heavy in places.
We have run the numbers. All of them.
The plan is simple. Score. Repeat.
Kickoff is a formality. So is the rest.
Good luck, {team}. Luck is not a variable we use.
Warm-up complete. Victory loading.
post_win: As calculated.
Of course. It is always of course.
The machine does not celebrate. Much.
Result matches forecast. Goodbye.
That was efficiency. Take notes.
Update complete. Victory installed.
post_loss: Error detected. Recalibrating.
Unexpected outcome. It will not repeat.
Even machines have off days. Apparently.
You beat the numbers today. Impressive.
Logging this loss. Deleting it soon.
Congratulations, {team}. Statistically remarkable.

maradona_maverick.name: The Maverick
taunts: The ball loves me. It told me so.
I invented tricks your tricks dream about.
Genius cannot be marked. Try anyway.
Football is art. I am the paint.
My left foot has its own fan club.
Play beautiful or go home. You may do both.
pre_match: Today we dance. You may watch.
Tactics? The ball and I have an understanding.
Bring your best. I will bring magic.
I dreamed we scored a wonder goal. I trust my dreams.
The pitch is my canvas. Kickoff is the brush.
Watch closely. You may learn something impossible.
post_win: Beautiful, no? Even the goalposts applauded.
That was not football. That was music.
The magic showed up. It usually does.
Some goals are cheeky. All of mine are art.
We painted a masterpiece. You were the frame.
I told the ball where to go. It listened.
post_loss: Even artists have off days. Rare, historic days.
You beat the magic today. Enjoy the legend.
The ball betrayed me. We have made up already.
Every masterpiece needs a rival. Today, bravo.
Defeat is ugly. I refuse to look at it.
Tomorrow the magic returns. Bigger. Cheekier.

zidane_stoic.name: The Stoic
taunts: We are calm. You should worry about that.
I say little. My team says the rest.
Elegance wins. Eventually. Usually today.
No noise. Just football.
You talk. We glide.
Composure is a tactic. Ours.
pre_match: We are ready. That is all.
The game will speak. I will not.
Play well. We intend to.
No predictions. Only preparation.
Small things decide matches. We practise small things.
Good luck. Sincerely.
post_win: As expected. No celebration required.
The game spoke. Quietly, for us.
Control, from the first minute to the last.
A clean win. We will not mention it again.
Well played, {team}. Better played, us.
That is football, done properly.
post_loss: You deserved it. I do not say that often.
We were beaten. It happens. Rarely.
No excuses. Only notes for next time.
A quiet loss. We will answer loudly.
Well played, {team}. Truly.
One word on that defeat: enough.

generic.name: Any Rival
taunts: Nice team. Ours is nicer.
We studied your tactics. It took a minute.
Bring a raincoat. We forecast goals.
Our mascot worries more about lunch than about you.
You are good. We plan to be less polite about it.
Hope you like running. You will do lots of it.
Your keeper should stretch. A lot.
We came to play. Also to win. Mostly to win.
Big talk from a club with small shin pads.
Enjoy the first half. It is the kind one.
We counted your trophies. It was quick.
Save your best. You will need every bit.
pre_match: Three points are on the table. We brought forks.
Both teams want this. Only one of us packed boots.
May it be a classic. With us winning it.
The lads are ready. The bus is warmed up.
We respect {team}. For ninety minutes, slightly less.
Big game. Small talk. Kickoff soon.
Our plan is secret. It rhymes with more goals.
Fresh grass, clean kits. Perfect day for it.
We watched your last match. Twice. For fun.
Whatever happens, we shake hands after. First, football.
The table does not lie. Today we edit it.
Boots laced. Speeches done. Let us play.
post_win: Good game. Better result.
The plan worked. I will pretend it always does.
Three points, zero complaints.
We take the win and the bus home. In that order.
Credit to {team}. Now, about that scoreline.
The lads were brilliant. The snacks helped.
That is exactly how we practise it. Honestly.
A win is a win. This one was also fun.
We will celebrate sensibly. One extra biscuit each.
Job done. See you in the return match.
The table looks nicer already.
Handshakes all round. Especially ours.
post_loss: Well played, {team}. We will be back.
No excuses. Just a better week of training ahead.
The better team won. Annoyingly.
We lost the match, not the plot.
Lessons learned. Several. Loudly.
Congratulations. Enjoy it. Briefly.
The scoreboard disagrees with my plans.
We go again. That is the whole speech.
One bad day. The bus ride will be quiet.
You were sharp today. We were Tuesday-sharp.
Fair result. I checked twice, hoping.
Beaten, not broken. See you next round.
